shows.title: A Sign of Affection
shows.synopsis: Yuki is deaf and has built a life of quiet beauty — meaningful friendships, a university routine, a rich internal world. When she meets Itsuomi, a multilingual student who is more interested in her than in communicating in her absence, she finds herself discovering what it means to be seen by someone who makes the effort. A romance that uses sign language as its central metaphor for the gap between how we present ourselves and what we actually want to communicate — and treats that gap with the delicacy it deserves.

shows.title: AnoHana: The Flower We Saw That Day

shows.synopsis: When they were children, six friends were inseparable. Years later, Menma's ghost appears to Jinta, the boy who was her closest friend, with a final wish she can't remember clearly. He has to reunite the group to fulfill it. shows.title: Attack on Titan
shows.synopsis: Humanity lives behind walls built to protect them from Titans — monstrous humanoids that devour people without reason. When the outermost wall is breached, Eren Yeager watches his mother die and swears to exterminate every Titan. What begins as a survival story becomes something far more complicated: a meditation on freedom, cycles of violence, and whether the people you're fighting for deserve what you'll become to save them. shows.title: Blue Lock

shows.title: Bocchi the Rock!
shows.synopsis: Hitori Gotoh (self-named 'Bocchi') is a guitar prodigy with crippling social anxiety. She taught herself to shred in her bedroom closet, dreaming of forming a band — except talking to people makes her literally dissolve into abstract art. shows.title: Bungo Stray Dogs
shows.nativeTitle: 文豪ストレイドッグス
shows.synopsis: Atsushi Nakajima, an orphan kicked out of his orphanage for being useless, accidentally saves Osamu Dazai — a suicidal detective from the Armed Detective Agency, an organization of people with supernatural abilities named after famous authors. shows.title: Chainsaw Man
shows.synopsis: Denji is a teenager so poor he sold organs to pay his dead father's debt to the yakuza. His only friend is Pochita, a chainsaw devil. When the yakuza betray him, Pochita merges with Denji's body, turning him into the Chainsaw Man — a human-devil hybrid recruited by a government devil-hunting division. Denji's motivation isn't heroism or revenge; he just wants to eat toast with jam and touch a girl. shows.title: Clannad: After Story

shows.nativeTitle: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ

shows.title: Dandadan

shows.title: Someday or One Day
shows.synopsis: Chen Yun-ru is a woman grieving the sudden death of her boyfriend, obsessively listening to a song from 1998. Then she wakes up in the body of a girl from that era — Wang Quan-sheng, the girl who looks just like her — and the boy who loved Wang Quan-sheng looks exactly like the boy she lost. A Taiwanese time-travel mystery that earns its complexity by making the emotional logic as precise as the plot logic, with Gregory Hsu's dual performance as the axis around which two timelines of tragedy and love orbit. One of the most discussed dramas in Taiwanese television history.

shows.title: Code Blue
shows.nativeTitle: コード・ブルー -ドクターヘリ緊急救命-
shows.synopsis: Four young doctors are selected for a helicopter emergency medical service fellowship — Japan's most elite and dangerous posting. shows.title: Sweet Home
shows.synopsis: Season 2 of the survival horror epic. In the aftermath of the Green Home apartment's collapse, survivors scatter across a world that is fully monstrous — and Cha Hyun-su grapples with the horror of his own transformation. The military tries to weaponize monsters; alliances fracture; the question is no longer whether you'll survive, but what you'll become. Darker, grander, and considerably more chaotic than the first season.

Hellbound fans of horror with philosophical texture — both shows use supernatural transformation to interrogate what society does to people at the edges, and neither flinches from the ugly answers

shows.title: Tale of the Nine Tailed
shows.synopsis: A nine-tailed fox living among humans confronts his past when a fearless producer investigates supernatural events.

shows.title: Tastefully Yours
shows.synopsis: Oh Seong-sun is a food writer who publishes a guide to Seoul's greatest unknown restaurants — using a pen name that has made her a legend in culinary circles without anyone knowing her face. When a private chef named Na Bong-tak starts appearing at every restaurant on her list, claiming to simply love good food, she suspects he's trying to steal her insider knowledge. Their culinary rivalry becomes the most elaborate flirtation either has ever conducted.

shows.title: Taxi Driver
shows.synopsis: A mysterious taxi service helps victims of injustice get revenge on those the law cannot touch.

shows.title: Tell Me That You Love Me

Oh Jung-eun is a young woman drifting after a painful breakup who collides with his carefully ordered life. shows.title: Temperature of Love
shows.synopsis: A screenwriter and a chef fall in love in a restaurant setting, navigating the challenges of their demanding careers.

shows.title: The Atypical Family
shows.synopsis: A family with supernatural abilities is targeted by a con artist woman who ends up falling for one of them.

shows.title: The Devil Judge

As he scrambles to maintain his lifestyle in a wealthy New Jersey suburb, he discovers uncomfortable truths about the people he thought he knew — and himself.

Suburban thriller dynamics with an ensemble of duplicitous neighbours echo 'Penthouse' and 'The Lies Within'

shows.title: (500) Days of Summer
shows.synopsis: Told out of chronological order, this is the story of Tom Hansen falling for Summer Finn — a woman who doesn't believe in love. A beautifully honest deconstruction of the romantic comedy that explores how we idealize relationships.

shows.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
shows.synopsis: A boy schemes to date a popular girl by paying a bad boy to woo her anti-social sister.

shows.title: 13 Going on 30
shows.synopsis: A 13-year-old wakes up in her 30-year-old body and must rediscover what truly matters as she navigates her glamorous but empty adult life.

shows.title: 21 Jump Street
shows.synopsis: Two incompetent rookie cops are sent undercover to a high school to bust a drug ring — the same high school one of them was a jock in and the other a geek, now reversed. Phil Lord and Christopher Miller's film takes its absurd premise completely seriously and uses it to say something true about how much of identity is performance. Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum's chemistry is one of the great comic duos of its decade.

Strongest Delivery Man fans of buddy-cop comedies with two leads whose individual weaknesses become strengths in combination — Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill have exactly that dynamic

shows.title: 27 Dresses
shows.synopsis: Jane has been a bridesmaid 27 times — always planning other people's happiness, never her own. A classic rom-com with a sharp edge: it's actually about self-sacrifice as a way of avoiding your own wants.

shows.title: A Beautiful Mind
shows.synopsis: The story of Nobel Prize-winning mathematician John Nash, who made revolutionary discoveries while battling paranoid schizophrenia.

shows.title: A Cinderella Story

shows.title: A Complete Unknown

shows.title: A Quiet Place
shows.synopsis: A family is forced to live in near-total silence as they are hunted by creatures that track by sound. A masterpiece of minimalist horror built around a genuinely loving portrait of family, parenthood, and the lengths we go to protect those we love.

shows.title: A Star Is Born
shows.synopsis: A seasoned musician helps a struggling artist find fame as he battles his own demons.

shows.title: About Time
shows.synopsis: A young man discovers he can travel back in time and uses this ability to find love and appreciate the moments that matter.

shows.title: Aftersun

shows.title: Arrival

shows.title: Atonement

shows.title: Barbarian

shows.title: Belfast

Kenneth Branagh's black-and-white memoir is a love letter to childhood, to place, and to the people we carry with us when we have to go.

shows.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

shows.title: Bridesmaids

shows.title: Call Me by Your Name

shows.title: Catch Me If You Can
